H0_definition: P/F structural agreement only; visual evidence audit pending; conservative interval union
shared_prompt:
You are reviewing an offline preparation video for a fixed tabletop robot task.
The only task information is the final goal: {instruction}
Use only the supplied frames from this video. Do not claim to have seen a
continuation, a simulator state, or an exact future success probability.
"Satisfied" means a visible condition needed for the final goal appears to
hold, not merely that an object moved. Cite only supplied frame seconds.
Set goal_observed_complete to "true" only if the final goal fully visibly achieved
its described end state in this video. If a required end-state relation is visibly
false at the end, set it to "false"; do not mark a preparatory condition as goal
completion. Keep this separate from before_satisfied and after_satisfied.
If the view cannot resolve object identity, occupancy, or an alternative route,
use "unknown" and say what is missing.
Return exactly one JSON object, no markdown and no per-frame number list.
Keep it compact: cite exactly two evidence entries, one before and one after
the event interval; each supports value must be one short string, not a list.
Use no extra keys and keep every free-text value below 20 words.
Required keys: goal_observed_complete (true/false/unknown as a string), relation
(one concrete goal-relevant visible condition), before_satisfied and
after_satisfied (true/false/unknown strings), comparison
(better/same/worse/unknown string), event_interval_s (two integer seconds 0..14),
evidence (list of objects with second, region, supports), alternative_route,
disconfirming_observation, uncertainty_reason (text or null).

method_prompts.D: Directly assess whether the observed action made progress toward the final goal, had no supported effect, or hindered it. Fill the event record with visible before/after evidence and any uncertainty.
method_prompts.P: Choose the single most decisive visible condition that the final goal may require. Prioritize whether the observed action changes an obstacle or affordance for the remaining goal. Do not choose a static fact merely because the goal mentions that object. If the action changes no goal-relevant condition, report same. Describe the chosen condition before and after using cited frames. Mention any other independent blocker you cannot inspect.
method_prompts.F: Independently compare continuing the final goal from the scene before and after this action. Try to disprove an apparent improvement: could the goal already have been achievable before, or could a blocker remain afterward? Name a concrete alternative route if visible; otherwise say unknown. Base the comparison on cited frames.
method_prompts.D2_review:
Review the previous direct event record below against the same supplied frames. Correct any visual or logical mistake; preserve uncertainty where evidence is insufficient. Return the same event schema. Previous record (untrusted draft, not extra visual evidence):
{prior}

progress_index_semantics: evidence index, not success probability or completed-work percentage
model_input_permission: final goal instruction and preparation video only; no truth, continuation, old scores
revision_reason: Before any new-test model output: explicit all-unknown 15-point curves for invalid/abstained outputs and for unknown final-goal completion; no prompt or sampling change.
unknown_curve: 15 points; point=null, lower=0, upper=100 for invalid or H0 abstention
